title: ProviderEvent
description: C-2 stream event yielded by ProviderAdapter.stream. A stream yields any number of deltas and ends with exactly one `done` or `error`. `index` is the position of the block in the final message content.

continuable.description: Explicit permission to continue from committed context, separate from same-request replay. Classified transient failures allow it; a pre-output recovery exhaustion with an explicit server_error or network cause may allow the bounded transcript-only continuation; missing/future causes, refusals, permanent and local failures do not.

malformed_tool_calls.description: Canonical identities of calls whose final JSON arguments were malformed. The matching partial carries safe empty arguments; the loop records an error result and never executes them.

after_thinking.description: The response streamed thinking and nothing else before this transient or unknown error; the loop retries it at most once per request (provider.md).

status.description: HTTP status, when there was one.

partial.description: What streamed before the error, with stop_reason `error` or `aborted`; never replayed as a valid response.

examples.message: prompt is too long: 213042 tokens > 200000 maximum
